items.en: Walking characters stay where you drop them, even in the middle of the screen, and walk along that height. Let go just above a window or the bottom of the screen and they still land on it.
items.zh: 会走的角色松手在哪就停在哪，屏幕中间也行，并在那个高度继续走动；在窗口或屏幕底边上方一点松手，仍会落到上面。

items.en: Characters that walk: a character package strolls along the bottom of the screen, turns, lies down and performs. Poke it for a random move, or pick one from the popover.
items.zh: 会走的角色：角色包沿屏幕底边散步、转身、躺下、表演；戳她一下随机来一个，弹窗里也能点名要哪个。

items.en: Standing on windows: drop a walking character on a window and it stays up there, riding along wherever the window goes.
items.zh: 站在窗口上：把会走的角色放到窗口顶上，她就站在那儿，窗口挪到哪跟到哪。

items.en: Up to three on stage: ⌘-click characters in the popover or the library.
items.zh: 最多三位同台：在弹窗或角色库里按住 ⌘ 再点角色。

items.en: A third skill, cameo-video-package, makes a walking character from one image and any image-to-video tool.
items.zh: 第三个 skill：cameo-video-package，用一张图和任意图生视频工具做出会走的角色。

items.en: Walking characters travel as a .zip: open or drop one on Cameo, add one from the gallery, or submit yours there.
items.zh: 会走的角色可以打包成 .zip：直接打开或拖给 Cameo，从画廊一键添加，也能在画廊投稿。

items.en: A little stage at the top of the library shows who is on the desktop, and right-click menus spell out their shortcuts.
items.zh: 角色库顶上多了个小舞台，谁在桌面上一眼就知道；右键菜单写上了快捷操作。

items.en: Clicks on the cat land where it is drawn, and right-clicks stay on the figure.
items.zh: 猫的点击区域和画出来的一致，右键始终落在角色上。

items.en: Right-clicking the figure opens its popover when you let go.
items.zh: 右键角色，松开时才弹出面板。

items.en: The popover stays put while the figure resizes.
items.zh: 调整大小时，面板不再跟着跳。

items.en: The library shows characters as a Finder-like lineup; a hidden Cameo waits in the Dock.
items.zh: 角色库换成 Finder 式的一排角色；隐藏时留在程序坞。

items.en: A character library window, in-place updates and 11 languages.
items.zh: 角色库窗口、原地更新，以及 11 种语言。

items.en: The character gallery and one-click Add to Cameo.
items.zh: 角色画廊上线，一键「添加到 Cameo」。
